steps.en: Install the desktop app and grant microphone and input permissions
steps.zh: 安装桌面应用，授予麦克风和输入权限

steps.en: Select a downloaded speech model and configure a shortcut
steps.zh: 选择已下载语音模型，配置快捷键

steps.en: Focus a text field, trigger recording and speak
steps.zh: 聚焦输入框，触发录音并说话

steps.en: Capture microphone audio while recording is active
steps.zh: 录音期间采集麦克风音频

steps.en: Trigger again to stop the recording
Recognize locally and paste the transcript into the current app
steps.zh: 在本机识别，把文字贴进当前应用

value.en: Dictate into an existing text field without moving a recording through a separate tool
value.zh: 直接向现有输入框听写，不再跨工具搬运录音
